issue: Dashboard total is higher than the source system
keywords: dashboard total higher revenue mismatch source system duplicate rows join
response: Check for duplicate rows and one-to-many or many-to-many joins. Then compare filters, date ranges, and aggregation logic between the dashboard and source system.

keywords: duplicate duplicates repeated rows records double counting
response: Identify the expected unique key and check whether it appears more than once. Review joins because one-to-many relationships can multiply records.

keywords: join incorrect sql many to many one to many duplicate rows
response: Validate the join keys and the relationship between tables. Compare row counts before and after the join.

keywords: null missing values blank calculation sql dashboard
response: Check how NULL values are handled in calculations and filters. Confirm what NULL represents before replacing it with a default value.

keywords: count distinct customers records different count duplicate
response: Compare COUNT(*) with COUNT(DISTINCT identifier). A difference may indicate duplicate rows or one-to-many joins.

keywords: date filter date range different periods dashboard sql
response: Confirm both reports use the same date field, date range, timezone, and inclusion rules.

keywords: dashboard stale old data refresh latest update
response: Check the last refresh timestamp and verify whether the ETL pipeline or scheduled refresh completed successfully.

issue: Revenue does not match finance report
keywords: revenue finance mismatch amount dashboard financial report
response: Confirm both teams use the same revenue definition and check refunds, cancelled transactions, discounts, pending payments, and recognized revenue.

keywords: power bi dax dashboard mismatch incorrect total
response: Review Power BI filters, relationships, DAX measures, and aggregation context. Compare the underlying rows with the source SQL.

keywords: kpi definition different teams metric mismatch business definition
response: Document the KPI formula, population, exclusions, date logic, and aggregation method, then confirm the definition with the business owner.

keywords: inner join missing rows dropped records sql join unmatched
response: Check whether unmatched records are being removed by an INNER JOIN. Test the logic with a LEFT JOIN and inspect the unmatched keys.

keywords: many to many join row explosion too many rows multiplied records duplicate
response: Check whether both tables contain multiple rows for the join key. Aggregate or deduplicate one side before joining if a many-to-many relationship is not intended.

keywords: dashboard dropped lower missing data sudden decline values decrease
response: Compare refresh times, source row counts, filters, and ETL job status. A sudden drop may indicate missing source data or an incomplete pipeline load.

keywords: timezone time zone utc local date mismatch dashboard sql
response: Check whether one system uses UTC while another uses local time. Convert timestamps consistently before comparing daily or hourly metrics.

keywords: aggregation grain level daily monthly customer transaction total mismatch
response: Confirm both reports aggregate at the same level of detail. Comparing customer-level data with transaction-level or monthly data can produce different totals.

keywords: average avg wrong weighted average calculation denominator dashboard sql
response: Check whether the metric requires a simple average or weighted average. Also verify whether duplicate rows are influencing the denominator.

issue: Missing records caused by NULL join keys
keywords: null join key missing records unmatched rows sql join
response: Inspect join columns for NULL values. Records with NULL join keys may fail to match and disappear depending on the join logic.

keywords: data type mismatch string integer varchar numeric join comparison sql
response: Check whether compared or joined fields use compatible data types. Cast values consistently before joining or filtering.

keywords: leading trailing spaces whitespace string mismatch join key text
response: Check text fields for leading or trailing whitespace. Trim values before joining or comparing them.

keywords: uppercase lowercase case sensitive mismatch string sql join
response: Normalize text values using UPPER() or LOWER() before comparison if the systems handle case differently.

keywords: duplicate transaction repeated id source ingestion double revenue
response: Check whether transaction IDs are unique and whether records were reloaded or appended more than once during ingestion.

keywords: cancelled canceled refunded orders revenue total completed status
response: Confirm whether cancelled, refunded, or incomplete orders should be excluded from the revenue calculation.

keywords: currency exchange rate usd eur conversion revenue mismatch
response: Verify that both reports use the same exchange rate, conversion date, source currency, and rounding rules.

keywords: rounding decimal precision cents small difference total mismatch
response: Check whether values are rounded before or after aggregation. Different decimal precision can create small reporting differences.

keywords: dashboard hidden filter report level page level visual filter mismatch
response: Review report-level, page-level, and visual-level filters. A hidden filter may exclude records that remain present in the source query.

keywords: row level security rls power bi permissions different totals users
response: Check whether row-level security is filtering data differently for different users or roles.

keywords: dax filter context calculate all filter power bi measure incorrect
response: Review the measure's filter context and any CALCULATE, ALL, or FILTER logic that may be changing the visible data context.

keywords: etl incomplete load missing rows pipeline failed partial data
response: Check ETL job logs, source-to-target row counts, failed tasks, and whether every extraction and transformation step completed successfully.

keywords: incremental load missing records watermark timestamp etl cutoff
response: Verify the incremental-load watermark or timestamp condition. Late-arriving or delayed records may be excluded if the cutoff logic is incorrect.

keywords: late arriving delayed records reporting cutoff yesterday today source
response: Check whether records arrived after the reporting cutoff. Determine whether the dashboard should support late-arriving updates or backfills.

keywords: wrong denominator rate percentage kpi conversion rate metric
response: Validate the denominator separately from the numerator and confirm that both use the same population, filters, and reporting period.

keywords: percentage over 100 greater than 100 rate dashboard kpi
response: Check for duplicate numerator records, overlapping categories, or a denominator that is filtered more narrowly than the numerator.

keywords: historical data changed prior month numbers changed dashboard
response: Check whether source data is being updated retrospectively, business logic changed, or slowly changing dimensions altered historical results.

keywords: dimension key surrogate key missing lookup warehouse unknown member
response: Check whether fact records match the expected dimension keys and whether missing dimension members are being handled correctly.

keywords: fact table duplicate grain warehouse repeated records key combination
response: Identify the intended grain of the fact table and verify that each key combination appears only once at that grain.

keywords: union union all duplicate repeated rows sql merge datasets
response: Check whether UNION ALL is preserving duplicate rows when UNION is expected, or whether the source datasets already contain overlapping records.

keywords: group by aggregation wrong total sql grouped columns
response: Review the GROUP BY columns and make sure they match the intended reporting grain. Extra grouping columns can split totals unexpectedly.

keywords: having filter group by missing groups sql aggregation
response: Check whether the HAVING clause is filtering out aggregated groups that should remain in the result.

keywords: where filter excludes rows missing data sql conditions
response: Review the WHERE conditions carefully and test each filter independently to identify which condition removes expected records.

issue: Date boundary off by one day
keywords: off by one day date boundary midnight timestamp inclusive exclusive
response: Check whether date ranges use inclusive or exclusive boundaries and whether timestamps around midnight are being interpreted consistently.

keywords: fiscal calendar calendar year quarter month mismatch reporting
response: Confirm whether both reports use the same fiscal calendar, quarter definitions, and period boundaries.

keywords: distinct count changes visual power bi tableau filters context
response: Check whether different visuals apply different filter context or dimensions that alter the distinct-count population.

keywords: cached extract tableau old data dashboard refresh stale
response: Check whether the dashboard is using a cached extract instead of a live connection and confirm the extract refresh schedule.

issue: Source and dashboard use different status logic
keywords: status logic active completed pending cancelled mismatch dashboard sql
response: Compare the status filters and business rules used by both systems. Different definitions of active, completed, pending, or cancelled can change totals.

keywords: snapshot transaction transactional daily snapshot mismatch report
response: Check whether one report uses a point-in-time snapshot while another uses all transactions over a period. These approaches can produce different totals.

keywords: slowly changing dimension scd type 2 historical attribute duplicate
response: Check whether multiple dimension versions are joining to the same fact record. Apply effective-date logic when using Type 2 slowly changing dimensions.

keywords: dimension duplicate values duplicate key lookup join multiplication
response: Verify that the dimension key is unique. Duplicate dimension rows can multiply fact records during joins.

keywords: missing foreign key orphan records warehouse unmatched dimension
response: Check for fact records whose foreign keys do not match dimension records and decide how unknown members should be handled.

keywords: window function partition by row_number rank duplicate sql
response: Review the PARTITION BY and ORDER BY columns in your window function. Incorrect partitioning can create unexpected rankings or duplicate selections.

keywords: latest record max date row_number most recent duplicate sql
response: Use a reliable ordering column such as timestamp plus a tie-breaker and validate that the latest record logic returns only one row per entity.

keywords: different source tables data source mismatch metric dashboard report
response: Confirm that both reports derive the metric from the same source tables or from sources with equivalent business logic.
